items.name: security-audit
items.title: Security Audit
items.description: Run a full-codebase security audit covering OWASP Top 10:2025 vulnerability classes, auth logic, secret handling, input validation, dependency CVEs, and supply-chain risk, producing a findings report ranked by severity. Broader than the secret-scan skill, which scans a single diff. Pass a path to limit the audit. Use when a full-codebase or module-level security review is needed.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
